policy: unbounded chronological acquisition from the Prophetic era through the present and future additions; there is no finite book-count target and no TOTAL-based stopping condition

chronology.primary_key: explicit Hijri chronology; author death Hijri is fallback; future additions remain ordered after known chronology

discovery_sources.name: Waqfeya
discovery_sources.role: edition and PDF discovery; rights remain a separate gate

discovery_sources.name: Internet Archive
discovery_sources.role: real PDF candidate discovery and acquisition

discovery_sources.name: Open Library
discovery_sources.role: edition and Internet Archive identifier discovery

rules: Discovery records are not automatically downloadable books.
A work, edition, volume and downloadable PDF are separate evidence layers.
Rights-unknown records remain catalogued but cannot pass the public acquisition gate.
Lost, fragmentary, manuscript-only and attribution-disputed works remain catalogued with explicit status.
Acquisition engines must consume this master namespace only; no legacy catalog path may be used as an acquisition input.
The queue is a resume state, never a second catalog and never a source of truth.
Verified PDF objects and their immutable hashes are never deleted by catalog cleanup.
